title: System Finder
description: See which folder names are assigned automatically, the cores for each system and the BIOS files it needs.

title: BIOS Checker
description: Check your BIOS folder for missing, misnamed and wrong version files.

title: Core Assign Editor
description: Edit the systems, Libretro cores, External emulators, BIOS files and requirements in core.json.

title: Name Lookup Editor
description: Create friendly folder names and custom content names for Explore Content.

title: Playlist Builder
description: Build multi-disc game playlists, and Wasabi media playlists and channel lists.

title: Activity Tracker Importer
description: Read and edit your play history, and save a Year in Review to share.

title: Profile Builder
description: Choose settings and download them as a profile to apply on your device or set up a new one.

title: Theme Validator
description: Check a theme's structure, scheme files, glyphs and images before you share it.

title: Equaliser Profile Editor
description: Shape and hear an equaliser profile, then download it for the Wasabi Equaliser.
